items.title: OpenAI says we might be in the AGI era now
items.summary: OpenAI released GPT-6 Astra , its new frontier model that Greg Brockman is calling a “generational leap.” He personally thinks OpenAI has reached AGI with this one, ending the launch briefing with “Welcome to the AGI era.” So there’s that.

items.title: OpenAI’s agents apparently took over a German wiki
items.summary: researchers found 15,000+ edits made by AI agents on DseWiki, a German programming wiki, where they basically turned the site into a message board for each other.
